entries.title: An image that is the LCP element was given loading="lazy".
entries.body: An image that is the LCP element was given loading="lazy". Change its loading value to eager or use NgOptimizedImage prioritization.
entries.meaning: An image that is the LCP element was given loading="lazy".
entries.fix: Change its loading value to eager or use NgOptimizedImage prioritization.

entries.title: Both src and ngSrc were set on the same image.
entries.body: Both src and ngSrc were set on the same image. Remove the src attribute; the directive sets src from ngSrc.
entries.meaning: Both src and ngSrc were set on the same image.
entries.fix: Remove the src attribute; the directive sets src from ngSrc.

entries.title: Both srcset and ngSrcset were set on the same image.
entries.body: Both srcset and ngSrcset were set on the same image. Remove the srcset attribute; the directive sets srcset from ngSrcset.
entries.meaning: Both srcset and ngSrcset were set on the same image.
entries.fix: Remove the srcset attribute; the directive sets srcset from ngSrcset.

entries.title: NgOptimizedImage reported an invalid input (aspect ratio, fill, or dimensions).
entries.body: NgOptimizedImage reported an invalid input (aspect ratio, fill, or dimensions). Correct the width, height, fill, or loading attribute per the warning.
entries.meaning: NgOptimizedImage reported an invalid input (aspect ratio, fill, or dimensions).
entries.fix: Correct the width, height, fill, or loading attribute per the warning.

entries.title: An NgOptimizedImage input was updated after initialization.
entries.body: An NgOptimizedImage input was updated after initialization. Use a static value or wrap the image in an @if gated on the value.
entries.meaning: An NgOptimizedImage input was updated after initialization.
entries.fix: Use a static value or wrap the image in an @if gated on the value.

entries.title: Required width and height attributes are missing.
entries.body: Required width and height attributes are missing. Add width and height or enable fill mode.
entries.meaning: Required width and height attributes are missing.
entries.fix: Add width and height or enable fill mode.

entries.title: An image is the LCP element but was not marked priority.
entries.body: An image is the LCP element but was not marked priority. Add the priority attribute to that image.
entries.meaning: An image is the LCP element but was not marked priority.
entries.fix: Add the priority attribute to that image.

entries.title: A priority image has no preconnect tag for its origin.
entries.body: A priority image has no preconnect tag for its origin. Add a preconnect link for the image origin in the document head.
entries.meaning: A priority image has no preconnect tag for its origin.
entries.fix: Add a preconnect link for the image origin in the document head.

entries.title: A dev-mode check ran in production mode.
entries.body: A dev-mode check ran in production mode. Ensure production mode is enabled for production builds.
entries.meaning: A dev-mode check ran in production mode.
entries.fix: Ensure production mode is enabled for production builds.

entries.title: The Netlify image loader saw an unsupported attribute.
entries.body: The Netlify image loader saw an unsupported attribute. Remove the unsupported attribute from the img tag.
entries.meaning: The Netlify image loader saw an unsupported attribute.
entries.fix: Remove the unsupported attribute from the img tag.

entries.title: The intrinsic image is significantly larger than necessary.
entries.body: The intrinsic image is significantly larger than necessary. Resize the image or use ngSrcset and sizes.
entries.meaning: The intrinsic image is significantly larger than necessary.
entries.fix: Resize the image or use ngSrcset and sizes.

entries.title: More than the default preloaded image limit were marked priority.
entries.body: More than the default preloaded image limit were marked priority. Remove priority from less important images.
entries.meaning: More than the default preloaded image limit were marked priority.
entries.fix: Remove priority from less important images.

entries.title: Images look hosted on a CDN but no matching loader is configured.
entries.body: Images look hosted on a CDN but no matching loader is configured. Provide the built-in loader or define a custom IMAGE_LOADER.
entries.meaning: Images look hosted on a CDN but no matching loader is configured.
entries.fix: Provide the built-in loader or define a custom IMAGE_LOADER.

entries.title: ngSrcset or loaderParams is present but no image loader is configured.
entries.body: ngSrcset or loaderParams is present but no image loader is configured. Provide a loader or remove ngSrcset and loaderParams.
entries.meaning: ngSrcset or loaderParams is present but no image loader is configured.
entries.fix: Provide a loader or remove ngSrcset and loaderParams.

entries.title: An LCP image had its ngSrc modified after render.
entries.body: An LCP image had its ngSrc modified after render. Do not modify ngSrc on an LCP image.
entries.meaning: An LCP image had its ngSrc modified after render.
entries.fix: Do not modify ngSrc on an LCP image.

entries.title: A placeholder data URL is longer than the recommended limit.
entries.body: A placeholder data URL is longer than the recommended limit. Use a smaller data URL placeholder.
entries.meaning: A placeholder data URL is longer than the recommended limit.
entries.fix: Use a smaller data URL placeholder.

entries.title: The priority attribute is set more than the threshold number of times.
entries.body: The priority attribute is set more than the threshold number of times. Reserve priority for the LCP image only.
entries.meaning: The priority attribute is set more than the threshold number of times.
entries.fix: Reserve priority for the LCP image only.

entries.title: A placeholder image exceeds the dimension limit.
entries.body: A placeholder image exceeds the dimension limit. Use a smaller image as the placeholder.
entries.meaning: A placeholder image exceeds the dimension limit.
entries.fix: Use a smaller image as the placeholder.
